title: AVAX 5m next-10-candle forecast
purpose: Named evaluation gate for the core ForecastPackage task: at each eligible AVAXUSDT 5m close, emit horizons h=1..10 and later score those frozen packages. This draft names the task, metrics, baselines, and leakage rules. It does not record any run and does not invent scores.

time_range.note: No canonical data manifest or sealed walk-forward window exists yet. Do not invent dates. A later sealed EvaluationPlan must name UTC start/end and a dataset checksum before this entry can leave draft.

horizons.note: Canonical forecast unit from wiki/Simulation-Accuracy.md. Cumulative from forecast origin unless a field is explicitly individual_candle.

metrics.name: mean_absolute_error
metrics.description: Return or price-path error as defined by the Evaluation Engine. Name only; no observed value.

metrics.name: root_mean_squared_error
metrics.description: Companion squared-error name to MAE. Name only.

metrics.name: direction_accuracy
metrics.description: Sign agreement. Must never be reported as a generic accuracy badge without horizon, window, sample count, and baseline.

metrics.name: brier_score
metrics.description: Probability quality for directional or event forecasts. Name only.

metrics.name: pinball_loss
metrics.description: Quantile loss (including q10/q50/q90 when those quantiles are emitted). Name only.

metrics.name: interval_coverage
metrics.description: Empirical coverage of forecast intervals (q10-q90 when those bands exist). Name only.

metrics.name: calibration_ece
metrics.description: Calibration / expected calibration error. Name only. No fabricated ECE.

leakage_rules.rule: No feature, model, label, resample, higher-timeframe aggregation, or context snapshot may contain information unavailable at the forecast timestamp.
Higher-timeframe features use only completed parent candles unless an explicitly named partial-candle namespace is defined and tested.
Scalers, calibration, model selection, and ensemble weights fit inside training or development windows only.
Target columns must never enter feature matrices.
Every live or simulated forecast must be journaled before outcomes are known. Historical predictions may not be overwritten to improve apparent accuracy.

validation_policy.note: Walk-forward or equivalent chronology-preserving validation is mandatory. Random time-series train/test splitting is prohibited for any accuracy claim.

pass_fail_rules.rule: A candidate that uses random-shuffle or other chronology-breaking validation fails this gate regardless of reported quality.
A complex model is not an improvement unless it beats the named baselines out of sample after fees/slippage assumptions where relevant. Exact deltas are unset until Watcher seals them.
A candidate must not be promoted by substituting a prettier error metric while interval coverage or calibration materially worsens. Materiality is unset until sealed.
Promotion review must inspect high-volatility and bear-regime slices, not only a pooled window. Slice tolerances are unset until sealed.
Promotion must not weaken or skip the avax-2026-09-failed-8 process regression.
Leaving draft requires Watcher approval and out-of-sample evidence recorded against a sealed plan. In-sample fit is not evidence.

notes: wiki/ML-FreqAI-Directive.md describes target walk-forward design guidance (multi-month 5m history and rolling train/validation/test lengths). Those durations are not a sealed window and are not scores. Baseline ids name Constitution §6 / Simulation-Accuracy mandatory families. Existing prototype helpers use labels zero and drift20; this entry does not claim those helpers have been scored on a frozen window.
